_doc: Settings for services/cost-tracker.js (docs/COST-TRACKER.md). Prices are USD per million tokens. Claude models are priced from services/anthropic-ledger.js PRICES (first-party list prices, 2026-10) and Standard Compute models from services/standard-compute-ledger.js PRICES; the entries below cover everything else. An entry with assumed:true is a planning assumption the owner should confirm against the provider's price page.

models.note: Modelflare Sol 6.1: cheapest paid route; price not published in the repo, assumed between the cheap-open and Sonnet rates (2026-11-02)

free_equivalent.note: What a free-tier model (NVIDIA, xKiro, UnoRouter, OpenRouter :free, Gemini free tier, local Ollama) would cost on a paid cheap route: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Standard Compute, 0.30 in / 1.20 out (services/standard-compute-ledger.js, 2026-10)

fixed_monthly_usd.note: Not set yet. Put the real monthly VM, domain and other fixed costs here (or COST_FIXED_MONTHLY_USD for a total) and the per-user share rows fill in.
